listeners.doc: Connects to an ActiveMQ Classic broker and dispatches messages to attached services.

serviceTypes.doc: Consumes messages from an ActiveMQ Classic queue or topic.

options.name: onMessage
options.doc: Invoked when a message is delivered from the configured queue or topic. In AUTO_ACKNOWLEDGE and DUPS_OK_ACKNOWLEDGE modes the message is acknowledged when onMessage returns, even if it returns an error, so it is not redelivered. To have a failed message retried, use SESSION_TRANSACTED and call caller->'rollback().

params.name: message
params.doc: The delivered ActiveMQ message. With the plain classic:Message type, the payload of a text or bytes message arrives as byte[] (text is UTF-8 encoded) and a map message as a map, so convert it before use, for example with string:fromBytes. To bind the payload directly, declare a narrowed record such as record {|*classic:Message; string payload;|}: a text message binds to string or xml, a bytes message to byte[] or a JSON-compatible type, and a map message to a map or a record of simple values.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Caller used to settle the message. acknowledge applies in CLIENT_ACKNOWLEDGE mode and also confirms every earlier message delivered by the session. commit and rollback apply in SESSION_TRANSACTED mode; after rollback the message is redelivered and becomes eligible for dead-lettering according to the redelivery policy and the broker's dead-letter policy. By default, a persistent message goes to ActiveMQ.DLQ and a non-persistent message is discarded.

options.name: onError
options.doc: Invoked when a message's payload cannot be bound to the declared type, or when onMessage returns an error. A binding failure is redelivered in every acknowledgement mode and becomes eligible for dead-lettering according to the redelivery policy and the broker's dead-letter policy; by default, a persistent message goes to ActiveMQ.DLQ and a non-persistent message is discarded. An error returned from onMessage is only reported here and is not redelivered in AUTO_ACKNOWLEDGE or DUPS_OK_ACKNOWLEDGE mode. A panic in onMessage is not passed to onError.

params.name: err
params.doc: The error raised while dispatching or processing the message.
